newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore shares open weaker, market contemplative.
newsitem.headline: Singapore shares open weaker, market contemplative.

text.p: The Singapore stock market opened in contemplative mood on Friday ahead of the weekend with investors sidelined and shares weaker, dealers said.
"The institutions are sidelined which is why the market is in the doldrums," a dealer at a local brokerage said.
At 0230 GMT, the Straits Times Industrials Index had slackened off 9.56 points to 2,034.15.
Market activity was muted with 41 million shares traded in opening exchanges.
Fraser & Neave led the 70-strong early sliders, down Singapore $0.50 at $10.60.

Jardine Matheson led 73 early risers to hit a new high for the year of US$7.80, up US$0.45 on healthy volume as market speculation grew about the company and its strategy after Hong Kong is handed back to China at the end of the month.

DBS Land was active again, slipping eight cents to S$4.66 as the market continued to figure out exactly what its intentions were toward healthcare group Parkway, in which it has just bought a 19 percent stake.
Parkway shares slipped five cents to S$6.55.
